name: Eci Technology Holdings Ltd.
summary: ECI Technology Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, founded in 2003 and based in Kowloon, that provides extra-low voltage solutions to public and private customers in Hong Kong and is a subsidiary of ECI Asia Investment Limited. Its segments are installation and maintenance, security guarding and electric vehicle charging. It designs, integrates and maintains audiovisual and security systems like CCTV, alarms, access control and car park systems for commercial buildings, malls, hospitals and government sites.
